name: quota cavern 12
detail:
note: the cavern ceiling is enforced on creature FREQUENCY, not on pool entries —
      entry quantity gates nothing underground (addendum 51). Managed cavern
      species are held at frequency 1 while the layer is over its ceiling.
      This brakes new ARRIVALS; it does not remove anything already down there,
      so a ceiling set below the current population is reached only as DF walks
